model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбова диаграма показва точността на различни модели в три категории: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, като всяка категория е представена чрез шест различни модела, означени с различни цветове: DAPO+ (синьо), DAPO (сиво), SRPO (оранжево), GRPO (жълто), PPO+Self-reflection (зелено) и PPO (светло синьо). Вертикалната ос показва процентната точност в диапазон от 50% до 62%, със стъпка от 2%. Хоризонталната ос изброява трите категории. За всяка категория стойностите са както следва: за Mathverse - около 53% за DAPO и PPO, 54% за DAPO+, 55% за SRPO, 56% за GRPO и PPO+Self-reflection; за MMLU - около 54% за PPO, 55% за DAPO и PPO+Self-reflection, 56% за DAPO+ и SRPO, 57% за GRPO; за Physics - около 54% за PPO, 57% за DAPO и PPO+Self-reflection, 58% за DAPO+ и GRPO, 60% за SRPO. Някои от стълбите са визуално групирани заедно според категориите, а цветовете на моделите са последователни във всички категории.
model_annotations.Chinese:
This bar chart presents a comparison of accuracy percentages across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, for seven different methods or models, each represented by a distinct color. The horizontal axis lists the three categories, with no apparent order or sorting. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy(%)", ranges from 50 to 62, with a linear scale and evenly spaced tick marks at intervals of 2. 

The chart displays seven groups of bars, with each group consisting of a blue bar, a dark blue bar, an orange bar, a brown bar, a green bar, a light green bar, and a gray bar, although not all groups have all seven colors. For Mathverse, the blue bar representing DAPO+ has a value of approximately 56, while the green bar representing PPO+Self-reflection has a value of around 54, and the light green bar representing PPO has a value slightly above 52. For MMLU, the orange bar representing SRPO has a value of approximately 56, and the brown bar representing GRPO has a value slightly below 56. For Physics, the blue bar representing DAPO+ has a value of approximately 61, the orange bar representing SRPO has a value of around 60, and the green bar representing PPO+Self-reflection has a value slightly above 58. Notably, the bars for Physics are significantly taller than those for Mathverse and MMLU. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, listed in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, marked with tick labels at regular intervals of 2. Each category features a set of grouped bars, representing different methods: DAPO+ (blue), DAPO (light blue), SRPO (orange), GRPO (yellow), PPO+Self-reflection (green), and PPO (light green). In the Mathverse category, the approximate accuracy percentages are 56 for DAPO+, 53 for DAPO, 55 for SRPO, 54 for GRPO, 54 for PPO+Self-reflection, and 53 for PPO. For MMLU, the values are approximately 56 for DAPO+, 56 for DAPO, 56 for SRPO, 55 for GRPO, 55 for PPO+Self-reflection, and 54 for PPO. In the Physics category, the values are around 61 for DAPO+, 58 for DAPO, 59 for SRPO, 58 for GRPO, 57 for PPO+Self-reflection, and 56 for PPO. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding as per the legend.
